items.name: Slowed
items.text: You have fewer actions. Slowed always includes a value. When you regain your actions at the start of your turn, reduce the number of actions you regain by your slowed value. Because slowed has its effect at the start of your turn, you don't immediately lose actions if you become slowed during your turn.

items.name: Slow
items.text: The zombie chuul is permanently Slowed 1 and can't use reactions.

items.text:

items.name: Mandibles
items.text:
Requirements A creature is Grabbed and Paralyzed by the zombie chuul's tentacles

---

Effect The creature takes 3d6 piercing damage.

items.name: Paralytic Venom
items.text:
Saving Throw DC 25 Fortitude save

---

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 Paralyzed (1 round)

items.name: Tentacle Transfer
items.text:
Requirements The zombie chuul has a creature Grabbed

---

Effect The zombie chuul transfers the grabbed creature from its claws to its tentacles, or vice versa. The creature is exposed to the zombie chuul's paralytic venom when transferred into the tentacles and at the start of each of the zombie chuul's turns if it remains grabbed by the tentacles.
